release_notes: The Dahua VTO4103FB is the black-panel variant of the VTO4103F 2-wire hybrid modular apartment door station: 2MP 1/2.5-inch 160-degree fisheye camera, 120 dB WDR, auto-IR night vision and half-duplex two-way intercom over digital 2-wire. Verified against the official Dahua DHI-VTO4103F/FB datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: 2-wire hybrid door station; requires a Dahua 2-wire controller/VTH. No documented direct RTSP/ONVIF path on the door station itself.
